query:
SELECT f.url
           FROM rulebook_files f
           JOIN rulebook_pages p ON p.url = f.page_url
           WHERE f.delisted_at IS NULL AND p.delisted_at IS NULL
             AND f.fetched_at IS NULL AND f.next_attempt_at <= NOW()
           GROUP BY f.url
           ORDER BY MIN(f.next_attempt_at)
           LIMIT $1
